2026-10-10-jantar-mantar|how do i get to.answer: Normally, you take the metro from Chandni Chowk via Chawri Bazar, New Delhi, Rajiv Chowk, Patel Chowk, and Central Secretariat to Janpath, followed by about a 4-minute walk to Jantar Mantar. Due to station closures, the detour requires walking directly from Chandni Chowk for about 60 minutes. This adds about 42.3 extra minutes to your journey.

queries.text:
MATCH (p:Place {name: $place})-[n:NEAR]->(s:Station)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c:Closure)-[:CLOSES]->(s)
RETURN s.name AS station, n.walk_min AS walk_min,
       c.id IS NOT NULL AS closed
ORDER BY n.walk_min

MATCH path = (x:Station {name: $a})-[:NEXT*1..3]->(y:Station {name: $b})
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.name] AS via,
       reduce(t = 0, r IN relationships(path) | t + r.minutes) AS minutes
ORDER BY minutes
LIMIT 1

MATCH path = (x:Station {name: $a})-[:NEXT*1..3]->(y:Station {name: $b})
WHERE all(i IN range(0, size(relationships(path)) - 2)
          WHERE NOT (nodes(path)[i + 1].name IN $no_transfer)
             OR relationships(path)[i].line = relationships(path)[i + 1].line)
RETURN [n IN nodes(path) | n.name] AS via,
       reduce(t = 0, r IN relationships(path) | t + r.minutes) AS minutes
ORDER BY minutes
LIMIT 1
